introduction_markdown:
**CAMEROON GENERAL CERTIFICATE OF EDUCATION BOARD - ORDINARY LEVEL EXAMINATION - CHEMISTRY (0515), Paper 2, June 2019. Time allowed: two and a half hours.**

This paper is arranged in three sections, A, B and C.

- Section A: answer 4 questions out of 5;
- Section B: answer 2 questions out of 3 and
- Section C: answer both questions.

In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed.

You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers.

enonce_intro_markdown: A homologous series of organic compounds has the general formula $\mathrm{C_nH_{2n+1}OH}$.
incertitudes: Le sujet se contredit : l'en-tête de la page de garde demande 4 questions sur 5 en Section A, mais le titre de la Section A dit « Answer ALL questions in this section ». La règle de l'en-tête est retenue.
Points imprimés 3 + 2 + 1 + 2 = 8, sans points imprimés pour la partie (c), pour « Total 10 marks » : recopiés tels quels, aucun point attribué à (c) (probablement 2 marks omis).
Le sujet imprime « Total 10 marks » (sans signe =).

questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) What is a homologous series?

(ii) Give the general name of this homologous series.

(iii) Name the second member of this series. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) A homologous series is a **family of organic compounds with the same functional group and the same general formula**, in which each member differs from the next by a $-\mathrm{CH_2}-$ group; the members have similar chemical properties and show a gradual change in physical properties.

(ii) **Alcohols** (alkanols).

(iii) The first member is methanol ($\mathrm{CH_3OH}$, $n = 1$), so the second member ($n = 2$, $\mathrm{C_2H_5OH}$) is **ethanol**.

questions.enonce_markdown:
Members of the above series can react with metals.

(i) Write a balanced equation to show how the second member of the series reacts with sodium.

(ii) Name the non-gaseous product formed in (b)(i) above. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) $2\mathrm{C_2H_5OH} + 2\mathrm{Na} \rightarrow 2\mathrm{C_2H_5ONa} + \mathrm{H_2}$

(Check: left 4 C, 12 H, 2 O, 2 Na; right 4 C, 10 + 2 = 12 H, 2 O, 2 Na. Balanced.)

(ii) The non-gaseous product is **sodium ethoxide**, $\mathrm{C_2H_5ONa}$ (the gas is hydrogen).

questions.enonce_markdown:
The second member of the series reacts with ethanoic acid.

(i) What name is given to this type of reaction?

(ii) Write an equation for the reaction.
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) **Esterification** (a condensation reaction forming an ester).

(ii) $\mathrm{C_2H_5OH} + \mathrm{CH_3COOH} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{CH_3COOC_2H_5} + \mathrm{H_2O}$

The reaction is catalysed by a few drops of concentrated sulphuric acid and the mixture is warmed. The ester formed is **ethyl ethanoate** (fruity smell).

(Check: left 4 C, 10 H, 3 O; right 4 C, 8 + 2 = 10 H, 2 + 1 = 3 O. Balanced.)

questions.enonce_markdown: State one simple test for members of this homologous series. *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown: Warm the compound with **acidified potassium dichromate(VI)**: the orange solution turns **green** (the alcohol is oxidised). Alternative simple tests: add a small piece of sodium and observe effervescence of hydrogen; or warm with ethanoic acid and a little concentrated sulphuric acid and note the fruity smell of an ester.

questions.enonce_markdown: State two large scale uses of the second member of this homologous series. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Ethanol is used:

1. **as a solvent** (in perfumes, paints, varnishes, medicines);
2. **as a fuel** (spirit burners, mixed with petrol as biofuel) and in the manufacture of alcoholic drinks.

(Also accepted: as an antiseptic or disinfectant.)
